title: Effect of acute metformin ingestion on blood lactate kinetics in type 2 diabetes patients chronically treated with metformin
summary: Das Ziel der Studie ist es, den akuten Effekt von Metformin auf die Laktatkinetik während drei verschiedener Situationen (Frühstück, aerober und anaerober Belastungstest) in Patienten mit Typ-2 Diabetes unter Metforminbehandlung zu messen.

interventions.name: Type 2 diabetes – metformin (On the experimental day, patients will take metformin for breakfast and a placebo for lunch. They will maintain their usual metformin dosage and frequency but will only reorder the timing of their medication.)

Type 2 diabetes – placebo (On the experimental day, patients will take a placebo for breakfast and metformin for lunch. They will maintain their usual metformin dosage and frequency but will only reorder the timing of their medication.)
